new_roles.title: Senior Director, Product Quality
new_roles.description:
»

**Date:** Nov 12, 2026

**Location:** North Reading, MA, US

**Company:** Teradyne

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

 

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

**Our Purpose**

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

 

**Opportunity Overview**

The Senior Director, Product Quality & Customer Excellence owns customer-perceived quality for Teradyne’s Compute Test Division, from design through the field. Reporting to the division’s VP of Engineering, this high-visibility role leads Software Quality Engineering and drives quality across hardware, software, FPGA, ASIC, applications, manufacturing, and service engineering. You will work with our executive team and largest customers to build the quality organization and reputation of the division.

* Lead customer escalations from first call to closure, driving Severity 1 and 2 escalations down 20 to 30% every year.
* Develop design reviews, risk analysis, and release gates that engineering respects and that stop a bad release.
* Collaborate with engineering leaders across organizations you do not manage, earning their commitment through credibility, data, and follow-through.
* Build trusted relationships with top customers, and cut field defect escapes every year while shipping every major launch clean through its first six months.
* Partner with leadership to show the cost of poor quality and the margin benefit of reducing it, and close more than 95% of corrective actions on time.
* Mentor and retain exceptional quality engineers, and develop the next generation of quality leaders.
 

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

* BS in Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience (MS a plus)
* Typically 15+ years in quality, engineering, product development, or applications, including 10+ years leading cross-functional teams on complex technical products
* A measured, visible quality turnaround or product launch you can point to
* Strong command of product development, verification and validation, reliability, and field operations
* Proven success building and leading teams, including managers
* Direct experience working with executive-level customers
* Ability to take a big, ambiguous, high-stakes problem and drive it to done without waiting to be pushed
* Accountability for outcomes, not activity: you set targets publicly, then hit them or own the miss, and you tell the truth early
* A customer-first mindset, leading and influencing across organizations by earning commitment
* Preferred: experience in semiconductor test equipment (ATE), test and measurement, capital equipment, networking, or enterprise infrastructure
* Preferred: product quality leadership in mission critical, complex hardware and software systems
* Preferred: a track record of using AI, automation, and data to measurably speed up root-cause analysis and problem closure
 

If this role excites you but your background does not match every bullet above, we would still love to hear from you.

 

*We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.*

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

 

**Compensation:**
 
The base salary range for this role is $228,200 - $365,100. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

**Incentive Plan:** This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance.

 

**Benefits:**
 
Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Engine & Plant Solutions Strategy
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
===================

This role defines how the GE Vernova Gas Power portfolio should evolve over a 5-year horizon and leads the front end of the hardware portfolio and NPI funnel. The leader converts shifts in customer needs, energy markets, technology, policy, competition, and adjacent value pools into an integrated portfolio architecture, prioritized opportunity pipeline, and decision-ready investment recommendations across heavy-duty gas turbines, aeroderivative gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, heat-recovery and balance-of-plant systems, equipment controls, and integrated engine and plant architectures.

 
 

The role matures outyear hardware and engine-solution opportunities until customer value, strategic fit, architecture, technical feasibility, economics, risk, ownership, and execution pathways are sufficiently defined for a Product Management decision. At that point, accountability transitions through a formal tollgate to Product Management, which owns funded commercialization, product roadmap execution, lifecycle performance, quality, delivery, and product cost.

 
 

Expected to work in a high intensity, sprint-based model, with high exposure to Power SLT on business-defining recommendations.

 
 

**Scope boundaries within the Strategy & Product Management team**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Joint seams:** Data centers, distributed generation, hybrid systems and other cross-portfolio opportunities require a named lead by value proposition. This role leads when the core question is engine, equipment, controls or plant architecture; Software & Services Strategy leads when the core question is digital/services value capture; New Business Industrialization leads when the opportunity requires venture incubation or formation of a new business.

**Owned by New Business Industrialization:** Startup-like opportunities, external or emerging technologies requiring venture-style incubation, new business models, sandbox or stand-alone operating structures, early commercialization, and industrialization pathways outside the established hardware portfolio. This role may identify or sponsor a signal, but transfers venture incubation accountability.

**Owned by Software & Services Strategy:** Software products, industrial data and AI, digital platforms, recurring-revenue models, software-enabled services, services transformation, installed-base service strategy, and the enterprise value proposition that combines software, controls and services. This role supplies hardware and controls-interface requirements but does not own that strategy.

**Owned by this role:** Long-range hardware portfolio architecture; heavy-duty and aeroderivative engine platforms; steam, generator and balance-of-plant hardware; equipment controls and controls interfaces; new centerlines and derivatives; physical plant and power-island architectures; hardware competitiveness; and transition of defined opportunities into Product Management/NPI.

 
 

**Organizational scope**
------------------------

* Reports directly into the VP Power Strategy, with a formal operating interlock to the head of Product Management and the Power executive leadership team.

* Leads 4-6 direct reports plus cross-functional opportunity teams formed around priority initiatives.

* Global scope across new units, installed base, services, software and controls, digital offerings, engine and plant-system solutions, and selected adjacencies.

* Owns portfolio recommendations and incubation governance, not engineering line management, product P&Ls, commercial execution, or lifecycle delivery after transition.

* Decision rights include opportunity admission, evidence requirements, incubation funding recommendations, gate-readiness certification, and stop/pivot recommendations. Final investment approvals remain with designated business governance.

 
 

Required Qualifications

 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, economics, finance, computer science, or a related discipline.

* Typically 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across portfolio strategy, product management, engineering, technology commercialization, services, commercial strategy, or corporate/business strategy in complex industrial markets.

* Demonstrated leadership of enterprise-scale portfolio choices, new-platform evaluations, or integrated solution development involving material investment and multi-year uncertainty.

* Deep understanding of industrial product economics, lifecycle value, R&D/NPI governance, customer buying processes, and commercialization.

* Fluency in financial modeling, scenario analysis, business cases, capital allocation, and option-based decision making.

* Evidence of leading through influence across senior stakeholders with competing incentives and no direct reporting authority.

* Exceptional written and verbal executive communication, including the ability to simplify complex technical and market choices without losing rigor.

* Ability and willingness to engage customers globally and travel as required.

 
 

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $248,000 and $341,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus

This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on 11/23/26.

Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chandler, AZ 85226

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations**

At **MPE** we are dedicated to making a difference in the world through cutting-edge medical technology. Our mission is to be the global leader in design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions for the medical and technology industries. We are committed to creating impactful solutions that improve lives and fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the medical field.

**A better career for you. Creating medical technology for all.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**We are seeking a dedicated Director of Operations to join our team.**

In this vital role, you will be responsible for all of the Company’s Manufacturing and Maintenance activities related to all MPE sites. The Director of Operations will plan, direct, coordinate, and oversee operations activities in the organization, ensuring development and implementation of efficient operations and cost-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where precision and teamwork matter, we’d love to hear from you!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a key member of the Leadership Team that develops, establishes, communicates and executes the strategic direction of operations while aligning with overall business goals and objectives and supporting customer requirements.
* Work closely with President/CEO to drive manufacturing plans, goals and future innovations including Lean, Six Sigma, Quick Response Manufacturing techniques and Continuous Improvement to evolve our World Class Organization.
* Ensure that, as the Company grows, our manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, responsiveness, lean, efficiencies, safety and best practices.
* Develop, recommend and manage budgeting and budget execution within functional area with a focus on costs savings, productivity improvements and quality assurance. Manage within the budgetary constraints. Analyze and report on variances between actual and budgeted expenditures
* Oversee all manufacturing engineering, production control, production process development, and preventive maintenance.
* Develop and implement processes, procedures and controls to promote efficient operations of the organization and ensure all Operations teams remain compliant to the processes, procedures and controls.
* Work closely with the Quality Team to ensure manufacturing processes are meeting customers’ requirements and required scorecard levels.
* Monitor and understand our customers’ and other outside agencies regulatory and quality system requirements and incorporate into our manufacturing processes while maintaining compliance.
* Ensure the training of new and present employees in the processes and methods required to achieve the organization’s standards for quality, quantity, and safety, consistent with the companies compliance and operational needs. Identifies additional training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided.
* Oversee the Company’s environmental, health and safety efforts in manufacturing to remain in compliance OSHA, EPA, State and local regulations and provide a safe working environment for our employees.
* Establish and maintain best practices for Manufacturing and Preventive Maintenance to develop and run a world-class manufacturer for medical devices. Ensure the maintenance of departmental housekeeping standards.
* Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in operations management.
* Presents periodic performance reports and metrics to the Chief Executive Officer and Leadership Team.
* Leader and Ambassador for MPE Cultural Values internally and externally.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field or equivalent experience

**Experience and Training:**

* At least 10 years of manufacturing and continuous improvement experience in a leadership role
* Experience in capital equipment and ROI analysis
* Experience low-volume, high product mix manufacturing
* Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and/or Quick Response Manufacturing techniques

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

* Regularly required to analyze, interpret data and documents, read and write business correspondences, present information, and problem solve.
* Must be able to read, write, apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Why Join Us?**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Help deliver medical products that change lives.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We support career development and internal promotions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:**
 + Medical (HSA-qualified and traditional plans), dental, and vision—coverage starts the first of the month after hire.
 + 401(k) with company match.
 + Nine paid holidays and vacation time from day one.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**If you're detail-oriented, team-driven, and ready to contribute to life-changing medical technology, apply today and grow your career at MPE.**

**No relocation or sponsorship available for this role.**

new_roles.title: Director - Service Operations
new_roles.description:
As the **Director of Service Operations** at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in **Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky**. Regional travel is required.

**Why Lumos:**

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.
* Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.
* Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.
* Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.
* Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.
* Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.
* Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.
* Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit:**

new_roles.title: Regional Director Operations-RD
new_roles.description:
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership, client partnership support, and strategic oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts within an assigned region. This position partners closely with community leadership teams, culinary operations, resident experience teams, and corporate leadership to ensure operational excellence, financial performance, hospitality culture, regulatory compliance, and elevated resident satisfaction across all assigned communities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is an exempt salaried position, with expected hours to include: days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Functions and Duties

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and operational oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts
* Support and mentor Directors of Dining Services, Executive Chefs, Resident Experience leaders, and community management teams
* Ensure operational consistency, hospitality standards, and service excellence throughout all assigned communities
* Conduct regular operational visits, audits, and performance reviews

Client & Resident Relationships

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client leadership teams, residents, families, and operational partners
* Ensure resident satisfaction initiatives and hospitality-focused service culture remain a top operational priority
* Participate in client meetings, operational reviews, and strategic planning discussions
* Address operational concerns and support service recovery initiatives when needed

Financial Management

* Manage regional financial performance including:

* labor management,
* food cost controls,
* budgeting,
* forecasting,
* and overall account profitability

* Analyze financial reports and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement
* Support implementation of operational efficiencies and cost-control initiatives

Culinary & Hospitality Excellence

* Support culinary innovation, menu development, dining presentation, and hospitality-driven service initiatives
* Ensure dining environments reflect company hospitality standards and resident experience expectations
* Promote elevated dining experiences throughout all communities

Associate Leadership & Development

* Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop operational leadership teams
* Support associate engagement, retention, succession planning, and performance management initiatives
* Foster a positive, professional, and accountability-driven culture throughout the region
* Assist with onboarding and transition support for new business and leadership changes

Compliance & Quality Assurance

* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local, and company regulations and standards
* Support sanitation, food safety, healthcare compliance, and regulatory audit readiness
* Conduct operational assessments and quality assurance reviews
* Ensure corrective action plans are implemented and maintained when necessary

Travel

This role will be 80-100% travel. Travel will be by car and/or plane and will include overnight travel.

General Responsibility as Required for Position

The Regional Director of Operations serves as the primary operational leader supporting community-level Directors, Executive Chefs, and management teams while helping drive consistency, service excellence, associate engagement, and overall client satisfaction throughout the region. This role requires strong leadership presence, hospitality mindse, financial acumen, and the ability to build strong operational partnerships within senior living environments

AAP/EEO Statement

Forefront will not discriminate based on race, color, sex, height, weight, disability, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, military service, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or any other protected class in its hiring practices, conditions for transfer or promotion, policies, discipline, discharge, terms, conditions or benefits of employment.

Other Duties as assigned

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Job duties, tasks, responsibilities, and activities may change from time to time.

Requirements:

Education/Experience/Training

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Hospitality Management, Culinary Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field
* 5+ years of progressive multi-site operational leadership experience
* Senior living, healthcare dining, hospitality, or foodservice management experience strongly preferred
* Strong financial management and operational analysis experience
* Experience leading large operational teams across multiple locations
* Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship management skills
* Strong problem-solving and organizational abilities
* Ability to travel extensively throughout assigned region

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Senior living dining and hospitality experience
* Multi-unit healthcare or hospitality operational leadership experience
* Culinary operations and resident experience knowledge
* Experience with client relationship management and contract dining operations
* ServSafe Certification preferred

new_roles.title: Director Practice Operations Community Cardiology
new_roles.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Cardiovascular Service Line and serves as a key leader at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across multiple community cardiology clinics in the Boston metro area.

Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the cardiology service line

This role plays a critical part in shaping the cardiovascular ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery of exceptional care across all cardiology sites.

Travel required to practice locations**:**

* Framingham (Heart Center Metro West)
* Melrose
* Merrimack Valley
* Norwood

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

3. Experience in Cardiovascular Service Line.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

 
$134,525.66 - $171,524.44

*based on full-time equivalent*

new_roles.title: Director of Branch Operations
new_roles.description:
**Eagle Title | Annapolis, MD**

**Reports To:** President

**Compensation Range:** Compensation is a combination of base salary plus performance-based commission tied to profitability and revenue growth across the branches.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Eagle Title is looking for a Director of Branch Operations to lead the profitability, growth, and operational excellence of Eagle Title branches (including Commercial and Builder Services Divisions).

Reporting directly to the President, this is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong business acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to develop high-performing leaders. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, holds branch managers accountable for growing their businesses, and builds the strategies, systems, and relationships needed for long-term success.

The right person understands that strong financial performance starts with strong leadership, clear expectations, efficient operations, and exceptional client service.

**WHAT YOU'LL LEAD**

**Branch Profitability & Growth**

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) performance of all branches, driving profitability, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Establish financial goals, growth expectations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each branch.
* Hold branch managers accountable for executing strategies that grow the business, strengthen referral relationships, and achieve revenue targets.
* Regularly review branch financial and operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies that deliver measurable results.

**Branch Operations & Strategy**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of branches, ensuring consistency, accountability, efficiency, and exceptional client service.
* Support branch managers in overseeing day-to-day operations, resolving challenges, and maintaining effective workflows.
* Develop and execute branch strategies that align with Eagle Title's financial goals and long-term business objectives.
* Establish standardized processes, performance expectations, and operational best practices across locations.
* Leverage technology, data, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, quality, and scalability.

**Leadership & Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers through clear expectations, regular performance discussions, measurable goals, and consistent accountability.
* Establish and monitor branch manager scorecards that track financial performance, business development activity, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with Human Resources to support staffing, training, performance management, and leadership development.
* Empower branch managers to take ownership of their teams, business development efforts, and overall branch performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Business Performance**

* Serve as a strategic business partner to Underwriting, Post-Closing, Marketing and other operational departments to strengthen workflows, resolve challenges, and deliver exceptional client experience.
* Collaborate with the President and Sales leadership to align branch growth strategies with overall company objectives.
* Identify and address operational challenges affecting transaction quality, turnaround times, profitability, and client satisfaction.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across departments to support successful transactions and organizational growth.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven leadership experience overseeing multiple branches, locations, or business units with responsibility for financial and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, financial analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success driving profitability, operational efficiency, and measurable business results.
* Experience coaching, developing, and holding managers accountable for business growth and operational performance.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into actionable plans.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Experience developing and monitoring KPIs, scorecards, and operational performance metrics.
* Ability to balance financial performance, operational priorities, employee development, and exceptional client service.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and leadership levels.
* Experience in title insurance, real estate settlement, or a related industry strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Experience with title production technology, including Qualia, preferred.

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
MHI Ship Repair & Services is a major marine repair and conversion contractor serving the U.S. Navy, Military Sealift Command, Maritime Administration and Commercial ship owners and operators worldwide. Our shipyard is conveniently located in the Mid-Atlantic region at the port of Hampton Roads, Norfolk Virginia.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Manages the operations of all production trades to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and the work efforts are coordinated and executed in a cost-effective manner, safely, and on time. Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.

**SUPERVISES:** All Shop Superintendents

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Primary oversight of all production departments to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for making strategic and tactical decisions related to certain aspects of MHI's production business to include operation non-Program work
* Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and that work efforts are prioritized, coordinated and efforts integrated between departments and executed safely, in a cost-effective manner and on time.
* Ensures performance is within the guidelines of the contracts, delivery orders are received and that all contractual requirements are within the scope of work for the specific market and are met for U.S. Navy, Government, private shipyard, and commercial projects.
* Holds daily production meetings with all trades and Project Managers. Communicate with all department heads to ensure that any manning, scheduling, tooling, and material issues are identified and resolved.
* Attend all SRA Production Meetings.
* Walks through all in plant vessels daily verifying all work in progress and identifying and resolving any issues as they arise.
* Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.
* Reviews and proofreads specs.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Estimating as requested.
* May on occasion be required to manage a project.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* College education and 15 years progressive experience in the maritime industry. (Apprenticeship and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.) Prior management experience a must.
* Ability to estimate.
* Basic knowledge of all skilled trades, and ability to manage effectively.
* Ability to communicate effectively as a leader.

MHI Ship Repair & Services offers competitive wages and an excellent benefit package.

Affirmative Action/EOE Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

new_roles.title: Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide a drug-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

 

**Notice to Search Firms:** *We are not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. We will not pay any placement, referral or other fees to any search firms unless we have agreed otherwise in a valid, written agreement for the specific position posted and signed by an authorized representative of Ashley Furniture Industries.*

 

***Please note this position is not eligible for current or future employment sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or at any time in the future.***

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations / Multi-Unit General Manager
new_roles.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Global Director, Supplier Quality
new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.

* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.

* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.
