existing_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**Ingram Content Group (ICG)**is hiring a **Sr. Manager Operations** to support our **Distribution** team in **Jackson, TN**. The Sr. Manager, Operations manages the daily operations of an assigned area within the Distribution Center and serves as a key partner to the Director, Operations. This role collaborates with the Director on hiring, safety and security, maintenance and repairs, non-product purchasing, and strategic planning to ensure customer service levels and commitments are achieved, while maintaining a zero-error environment.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization. We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency. Safety is a core value in our operations environment. We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs. Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways. If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

**Schedule:**

* Monday-Friday, first shift, with flexibility to work weekends, additional hours, and provide on-call support as business needs require.

**What You’ll Need:**

* College degree OR HS diploma or GED with directly related year-for-year experience
* 6 years’ experience in a high-volume distribution center OR production/manufacturing facility with a clear track record of success
* 5 years’ experience supervising at least 25 or more employees

**What You’ll Do:**

* Achieve and maintain full working knowledge of all aspects of the assigned operation
* Implement a fast-paced, lean distribution system; drive the delivery of products and orders on time.
* Oversee KPIs, goals, and objectives for the management team; set clear goals and expectations for Managers and Area Managers, measure performance, provide feedback, and hold leaders accountable.
* Build a passionate team with a positive, inclusive, results-oriented culture; mentor and develop leaders and staff; manage staff selection and development, ensuring associates are fully trained and cross-trained on systems and procedures.
* Develop, manage, and lead continuous process improvement strategies and initiatives; leverage Lean, Six Sigma, and Performance Improvement tools to enhance productivity.
* Provide strategic-level/long-term planning (3, 6, and 12 months out), including labor planning, rate forecasting, and peak season planning.
* Work closely with support functions (HR, Maintenance/Engineering, Safety, IT, and other leaders) to build and secure support and resources for projects and initiatives.
* Ensure customer service levels exceed requirements and standards; works with management to improve cost-per-unit (CPU)/cost-per-line (CPL) while providing outstanding customer service.
* Collaborate with Senior Management in the planning, development, and launch of processes and strategies for the site; review competitive information and visit other companies to bring in new ideas on operations.
* Oversee the supervision of the operations area, ensuring the timely and accurate movement of materials into and out of the facility.
* Monitor and execute company policies and procedures for HR-related issues, including associate attendance, timekeeping, and performance reviews.
* Control and manage budget costs for all assigned departments/areas.

**Essential Physical Demands:**

* Ability to walk and stand as needed
* Ability to grip/grasp as needed
* Ability to lift/carry in full range of motion up to 60lbs as needed
* Ability to push/pull in a warehouse environment up to 70lbs force to push as needed
* Ability to bend, squat/kneel, twist/turn, climb, crawl, reach above shoulder, and type/keyboard frequently
* Ability to work a flexible which could include nights and weekends
* Ability to travel as needed
* Exposure to wide range of temperatures

*Hiring Salary Range: $113,201k - $143,945k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to: the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.*

 **Additional Information**

**Perks/Benefits:**

* A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA.
  + 15 vacation days & 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days
  + 401K match, Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more
* Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program
* Financial and in-kind opportunities to engage with non-profits in your community
  + Company match program for United Way donations
  + Volunteer opportunities and in-kind drives for non-profits throughout the year
* Casual Dress Code

The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. Providing comprehensive services for publishers, retailers, libraries and educators, Ingram makes these services seamless and accessible through technology, innovation and creativity. With an expansive global network of offices and facilities, Ingram’s services include digital and physical book distribution, print-on-demand, and digital learning. Ingram Content Group is a part of Ingram Industries Inc. and includes Ingram Book Group LLC, Ingram Publisher Services LLC, Lightning Source LLC, Ingram Library Services LLC, Tennessee Book Company LLC, Ingram Content Group UK Ltd. and Ingram Content Group Australia Pty Ltd.

protected_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **About Shield AI:**

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

### **Job Description:**

We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.

You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales.

This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements.

We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving.

**What you'll do:**

* **Build quality into prototype and launch**

  + Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve.
  + Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans.
  + Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented.
  + Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds.
  + Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks.

  **Establish the Seattle quality operation**

  + Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows.
  + Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements.
  + Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions.
  + Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions.

  **Deliver quality at rate**

  + Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow.
  + Lead containment, root cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing quality issues, with clear functional ownership and verification that fixes prevent recurrence.
  + Own the nonconformance and MRB process, ensuring disposition decisions follow approved technical authority and that affected hardware remains controlled.
  + Partner with Supply Chain and supplier quality teams to resolve incoming quality issues and improve supplier performance before defects disrupt aircraft builds.
  + Work with Engineering and Production to define acceptance evidence and ensure aircraft meet approved requirements before release.
  + Use digital quality tools and manufacturing data to strengthen traceability, expose trends and reduce manual administration as production scales.
  + Give leadership a clear view of quality performance, product risks and readiness; escalate or stop affected work when requirements or product integrity cannot be assured.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in quality, product assurance or reliability within aerospace, defense technology or high-reliability manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success leading quality through prototype or new product introduction and into sustained production.
* Proven ability to build and scale quality teams and systems while supporting fast-paced development and manufacturing operations.
* Deep expertise in containment, root cause analysis, MRB, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001, with practical implementation and audit leadership experience.
* Experience with complex assembly, inspection, configuration control, traceability and product acceptance.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively across Engineering, Production and Supply Chain.
* A hands-on leadership style and sound technical judgment, balancing timely execution with clear quality standards and accountability.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through production launch and rate ramp.
* Experience establishing quality capability at a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites.
* Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration, production test and reliability improvement.
* Experience deploying digital quality systems, statistical process controls and data-driven defect prevention.
* Advanced degree in engineering, quality or a related technical discipline.

**NOTICE: The posting for local applicants only - is not for those applying for a global assignment and/or for employees working outside of Cipla's U.S. Subsidiaries or Affiliates.**

  

**Job Title**: Senior. Manager, Quality Control

**FLSA Classification**: Full-Time, Exempt Professional

**Work Location**: Central Islip, NY (Unit 3)

**Work Hours:** General Shift: 8:30AM – 5:00PM (may vary based on business needs)

**Reports To**: Quality Control Director

**Salary: $103,000 - $136,000**

  

**Position Summary**

The Manager, Finished Product & Stability Quality Control is responsible for leading all analytical testing, stability program execution, laboratory compliance activities, investigations, and personnel management associated with Finished Product and Stability testing. The role ensures compliance with cGMP, FDA, ICH, USP, Data Integrity, and internal quality requirements while supporting product release, stability commitments, regulatory inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Finished Product and Stability testing activities to support commercial product release and ongoing stability programs.
* Oversee testing and review of assay, related substances, chromatographic purity, degradation products, dissolution, content uniformity, residual solvents, and other compendial requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of stability sample pulls, testing, data review, trending, and reporting activities.
* Lead laboratory investigations including OOS, OOT, deviations, atypical results, and CAPA implementation.
* Review and approve analytical data, laboratory records, chromatograms, and technical reports.
* Support method verification, method transfer, process validation, cleaning validation, and troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure inspection readiness and actively support regulatory and customer audits.
* Supervise, train, mentor, and develop laboratory personnel while ensuring efficient workload distribution and resource utilization.
* Partner with QA, Manufacturing, Validation, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and R&D to meet business and compliance objectives.
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of pharmaceutical Quality Control experience with at least 3-5 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
* Strong experience supporting FDA-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

  

**Technical Knowledge & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in Finished Product and Stability sample testing within a pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratory. Experience with Raw Material testing is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of chromatographic techniques including assay testing, related substances (impurity profiling), degradation product analysis, and chromatographic purity determination using HPLC, UPLC, GC, and IC systems.
* Proficient in operation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of analytical instruments including HPLC, UPLC, GC, IC, Dissolution Testers, Karl Fischer, FTIR, UV-Vis, and XRPD.
* Thorough understanding of Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) product testing requirements and regulatory expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in pharmaceutical analytical methodologies, laboratory investigations, data review, and compliance-driven laboratory operations.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, Data Integrity requirements, USP, ICH guidelines, and FDA expectations.
* Experience with chromatography data systems and laboratory software including Empower, LabSolutions, Tiamo, and other computerized laboratory systems.
* Working knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), and Quality Management Systems such as TrackWise.
* Demonstrated experience in method execution, method troubleshooting, data review, technical assessments, and investigation management.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits, including USFDA, customer, and corporate audits.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills with the ability to effectively manage teams and collaborate across functions.

  

**GLOBAL COMPANY**

  

Cipla is a leading global pharmaceutical company, dedicated to high-quality, branded and generic medicines. We are trusted by healthcare professionals and patients across geographies. Over the last eight decades, we have strengthened our leadership in India’s pharmaceutical industry and fortified our promise of strengthening our global focus by consolidating and deepening our presence in the key markets of India, South Africa, the U.S., and other economies of the emerging world.

  

Cipla employs handpicked professionals not just for their knowledge and experience but for their zeal to make a difference to the world of healthcare. The company believes that our biggest assets are the employees, who lead us to prosperity and growth in the future. Driven by the vision, none shall be denied, Cipla’s focus has always been on making affordable, world-class medicines with a reputation for uncompromising quality standards across the world.

About InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, a Cipla subsidiary InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of generic prescription medicines with focus on a range of therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, anti-infective, CNS, anti-inflammatory, anti-diabetic, and anti-depressants. protected_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K
